title: Folder editor closed while its save is in flight: a failed save is never reported
trigger: Edit a folder, press Save (editor goes FolderLoad::Saving(request)), then Cancel/Esc/close before the answer. Cancel stays enabled while saving and sets folders.editor = None
effect: The save request's answer is not handed to closed_asks (only Share and Invite boxes do that), so a server refusal produces no toast and the folder silently stays unchanged; the answer lingers in dialog_answers until the ring drops it
fix: On editor close while Saving(request) insert ClosedAsk::FolderSaved into closed_asks (same path as FolderAdded/LinkChange)

title: Event log search query stored before the refetch is sent; a failed send leaves query and list out of step
trigger: Type a search in recent actions while the driver send fails (connection path down): set_chat_event_log_query stores the query, refresh_chat_event_log errs
effect: Error note shows, but the list keeps old rows labelled for the old query; the next apply compares text to the stored query and returns early, so the same text is never re-sent until it changes
fix: Store the query only with the request it sent (query held in the Fetch::Loading stage)

title: Folder boxes wait on dialog_answers only; an answer dropped from the ring leaves Saving/Checking/Adding for good
trigger: Share Folder Saving(request), invite Checking/Adding, recommended_adds or deletes wait while more than KEPT other dialog answers arrive before the poll takes theirs
effect: Spinner and disabled buttons stay until the box is closed (settle_closed_folder_asks handles requests.get(request).is_none(), the open-box paths do not); a recommended-folder row spins until the screen is replaced
fix: One settle helper that also ends a stage whose request is no longer in session.requests, as closed asks do

title: drive_folder_invite re-sends fetch_chats_for_folder_invite every poll tick after a failed send
trigger: Open an addlist box with chats the session does not know while the driver send keeps failing
effect: sent stays false so asked_chats is never marked and the same send is attempted on every poll until the box closes (wasted work, no state to stop it)
fix: Mark asked per chat in a Fetch-like stage (Idle/Asked/Failed) so a failed send is shown once

title: Folder reorder has no in-flight stage: each click sends a full order built from the session's not yet updated order
trigger: Click Move up on folder B, then Move down on folder C before updateChatFolders arrives
effect: The second request is computed from the old order and overrides the first, so the first move is lost without any message
fix: Hold a Reordering(request) stage and ignore or queue moves until the update lands

title: Craft flow is split between GiftMarketUi::craft (CraftStage) and the session's CraftSession::run, reset together by hand
trigger: craft_now sets CraftStage::Forging via start_forge while the session's CraftRun::Crafting is set by the driver; craft_frame_upkeep and after_craft_pop end both separately
effect: No bug today (comments say the forge holds only the clock); a path that ends one half and not the other leaves a forge with no craft or a craft with no forge
fix: One CraftStage owned by the session whose Forging variant holds the request and the clock

title: hide_name is kept twice: payments.gift_inputs.hide_name (send and resale buy) and gift_market.flow.hide_name (auctions)
trigger: A user ticks Hide my name in the auction send box, then opens a resale buy from the same send box (or the reverse)
effect: The choice does not carry between the two boxes of one gift flow; two stores must be reset together (reset_gift_choices vs MarketFlow::drop_orphans)
fix: One SendGiftChoices value owned by the open gift flow

title: baseline: clock_task re-arms itself every beat (allow-listed owned timer)
trigger: Any animated content asks for ticks; each beat of clock_task spawns the next beat from inside itself and hands it to ClockLoop::Running
effect: No bug today: the stage owns the one task; the guard allow-list keeps the self-spawning loop shape
fix: Run the clock as one task owned by the stage (loop with a stop signal) instead of one task per beat
